# Visit Sahara Desert

> Morocco-based Sahara Desert tour operator run by native Berber (Amazigh) guides. We run authentic private and group desert experiences — camel trekking, desert camping, sandboarding, and cultural immersion — departing from Marrakech, Fes, Casablanca, Agadir, and Errachidia.

Private tours for any group size, plus shared group tours of up to 17 people. Tours are operated in 5 languages (English, French, Arabic, Spanish, German). No single-use plastics in the desert, exclusive partnerships with local Berber communities, and 10% of every booking contributed to desert community programmes.

## Tours

- [All Tours](https://www.visitsaharadesert.com/tours): Full listing of Sahara Desert tours (2–15 days), filterable by departure city and price.
- [Tours from Marrakech](https://www.visitsaharadesert.com/tours/marrakech): Cross the High Atlas and Draa Valley to Erg Chebbi.
- [Tours from Fes](https://www.visitsaharadesert.com/tours/fes): Via the Ziz Valley to Merzouga.
- [Tours from Casablanca](https://www.visitsaharadesert.com/tours/casablanca): Multi-day imperial cities and Sahara circuits.
- [Tours from Agadir](https://www.visitsaharadesert.com/tours/agadir): Desert trips from Morocco's Atlantic coast.
- [Tours from Errachidia](https://www.visitsaharadesert.com/tours/errachidia): Shortest route into Erg Chebbi.

## Destination & Planning Guides

- [Merzouga & Erg Chebbi](https://www.visitsaharadesert.com/merzouga-erg-chebbi): Guide to Morocco's best known Sahara dunes, how to get there and how long to stay.
- [Luxury Desert Camps](https://www.visitsaharadesert.com/luxury-desert-camps): What luxury camps in the Sahara offer and which tours include them.
- [Family Morocco Tours](https://www.visitsaharadesert.com/family-morocco-tours): Planning a Sahara trip with children.
- [Honeymoon Morocco Tours](https://www.visitsaharadesert.com/honeymoon-morocco-tours): Private desert trips for couples.
